reason: The done/push/shrink/drop prompt is a nicer take on the guilt problem than what Sunsama gave me, and $12 undercuts it, but I can't find a single Reddit thread or YouTube comparison on Moduo. I'd maybe poke at the free plan, but I'm not paying for a new all-in-one app with no track record while my Apple Notes list still works.
objection: It's an unknown app trying to also be my notes, contacts and email. I've been burned by planners I abandoned after two weeks, and the end-of-block prompt could easily turn into a fresh nag that makes me feel behind all over again.
would_change_my_mind: Honest reviews or a side-by-side YouTube comparison against Sunsama and Akiflow from people who've used it for a few months, plus a way to bring in my existing Apple Notes list without retyping it.
